options.text: Bare survival pay is always enough.
Workers deserve a decent standard of living.
The state alone sets all wages.

questions.explanation: Workers deserve a decent standard of living. The wrong options accept subsistence, deny duty, or shift setting to the state.

questions.topic: A week of hours at two mills
questions.stem: Two mills report weekly hours of 60 and 45 respectively for the same job.

answer.exemplar: The 15-hour gap exposes unequal labor conditions, showing how quantitative comparison can reveal disparities that qualitative complaint alone cannot establish.

questions.explanation: The 15-hour gap exposes unequal labor conditions. Quantitative comparison reveals disparities qualitative complaint cannot.

questions.topic: The objection that widens the target

stimulus.body: An objection that starts with one abuse often ends by indicting the whole order, so the target grows from a single practice to the system itself.

questions.stem: On the quoted view, how does the target change?

options.text: It stays fixed on one practice.
It grows from one practice to the whole system.
It narrows to a smaller target.

questions.explanation: The target grows from one practice to the whole system. The wrong options deny, confuse, or reverse.
questions.hint: Find the growth described in the quote.

questions.topic: Leisure as a trade and as a duty
